newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* Ringgit eases afresh in the wake of Indonesia abandoning the rupiah's intervention band system. On Friday morning it eased to 2.78 a dollar from 2.7650 at close of Kuala Lumpur trading on Thursday.
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average resumed its upward trend after a two-day correction ending 14 points higher at 7,942
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index extends gains in a technical rebound to end 9.71 points higher at 918.54
* Prime Minister's comment that Malaysia's eight percent GDP growth target for the year was achievable expected to have an impact, brokers said.
* "I don't think there will be very heavy trading ahead of the weekend. It should be a fairly steady day, with more possibilities of gains," said a foreign brokerage analyst.
